scripts.sync-env: echo VITE_API_URL=$(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name kdmeusalario --region us-east-1 --profile ${AWS_PROFILE:-AWSAdministratorAccess-101134489565} --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='ApiUrl'].OutputValue" --output text) > .env
scripts.deploy: sam build --template-file infra/template.yaml --build-dir infra/.aws-sam/build && sam deploy --template-file infra/.aws-sam/build/template.yaml --stack-name kdmeusalario --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --resolve-s3 --no-confirm-changeset --region us-east-1 --profile ${AWS_PROFILE:-AWSAdministratorAccess-101134489565} && npm run sync-env && npm run build && echo '✔ Deploy completo. Rode npm run dev para acessar.'
scripts.destroy: aws s3 rm s3://kdmeusalario-invoices-$(aws sts get-caller-identity --profile ${AWS_PROFILE:-AWSAdministratorAccess-101134489565} --query Account --output text) --recursive --profile ${AWS_PROFILE:-AWSAdministratorAccess-101134489565} --region us-east-1 && sam delete --stack-name kdmeusalario --no-prompts --profile ${AWS_PROFILE:-AWSAdministratorAccess-101134489565} --region us-east-1
